description: Administrative interface for managing user permissions, roles, and organizational access. Allows viewing, editing, and managing user role assignments across the organization.

pages.name: UserManagementComponent
pages.description: This page provides an administrative interface for managing user permissions, roles, and organizational access within the system. You can view, edit, and assign user roles across the entire organization, ensuring proper access control and security.

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're having trouble finding a user or understanding their access, use the available filters to narrow down the list (you can search by name/email, or filter by role or organizational unit). To change a user's access, click the 'Edit' button next to their name. Remember that different roles grant different levels of access to system features. If you only want to see users in your department, use the 'My Org Unit Only' toggle.
common_tasks: Finding a user: Use the search box to type a user's name or email, or apply role/organizational unit filters.
Changing user roles: Click the 'Edit' button next to the user's entry, select or deselect the appropriate role checkboxes, and then save your changes.
Filtering by organization: Toggle the 'My Org Unit Only' switch to view users only within your assigned organizational unit, or use the organizational unit dropdown if available.
Managing access levels: Assign roles such as 'Admin' for full control, 'Standard User' for general access, or specific custom roles as needed to define user capabilities.
Bulk management: Utilize the table's filtering, sorting, and pagination features to efficiently manage a large number of users.
